test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Parts of the following sentence are given as options. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

She don’t go for a walk everyday.
solution: The correct answer is** 'She don't'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here, '**doesn't**' should be used instead of '**don't**'. • The present simple third-person singular verb form is '**does**'. • '**She**' is a **singular subject.** Hence, it should be followed by **a singular helping verb**. • Thus, the erroneous part is **'She don't'.** **Correct Sentence:__** *She doesn't go for a walk everyday.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहाँ '**don't**' के स्थान पर '**doesn't**' का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए। • वर्तमान सरल तृतीय-व्यक्ति एकवचन क्रिया रूप '**does**' है। • '**She**' एक **singular subject** है। इसलिए, इसके बाद एक **singular helping verb **होनी चाहिए। • इस प्रकार, गलत हिस्सा** 'She don't'** है। da:T18c1, The correct answer is **'Art classes for children were being taken by a ten-year-old girl'.**
